data.title: 神尾观铃 · 旧校舍阶梯的黄昏印记
data.description: 放学后的黄昏旧校舍楼梯转角，橙色百褶裙被掀至腰际。观铃一手扶着木制扶手，另一只手按住自己被吻红的嘴唇，在高挑与纤细的交汇处战栗着迎接着极致的充实。
data.location: empty nostalgic wooden schoolhouse staircase landing bathed in fiery dusk
data.action: 观铃一手扶着木制扶手，另一只手按住自己被吻红的嘴唇
data.lighting: intense copper-red sunset beams pouring through tall arched windows
data.promptProse: On a quiet wooden schoolhouse stair landing flooded with copper-red sunset light, Misuzu steadies herself against the banister with one hand and presses the other to her parted lips. Wearing her ivory sailor blouse and dark tie with her high-waisted orange pleated skirt hitched above her bare thighs, she blushes deeply in the golden dusk.
data.animaCaption: Steadying herself against the wooden staircase banister with one hand while pressing trembling fingers to her flushed lips, she stands in her ivory sailor blouse with her golden-orange skirt hitched up her bare thighs. Fiery copper sunset beams stream across the empty landing.
data.nsfwProse: She wears her ivory short-sleeved sailor blouse with dark tie and high-waisted golden-orange pleated skirt hitched high up her bare thighs.
